verdict.rationale: iTerm2 supports background automation primitives — regex-based triggers that fire actions (run commands, scripts, notifications) automatically when text appears, plus a full Python scripting API and AppleScript support for writing standalone automation scripts — which could be used to build autonomous background behaviors. However, this is general terminal scripting/automation, not an AI-native agent framework; there's no evidence of scheduled/persistent agentic tasks, AI-driven autonomous triggers, or first-class 'run this AI task unattended' tooling beyond the optional AI chat plugin. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-specific autonomous background tasks, scheduling/orchestration features, and independent confirmation that Python API scripts can run persistently unattended as agents.
